 Print RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026: Exam dates announced for 590 vacancies, check details The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have released the RRB JE admit card 2026 for the first-stage Computer-Based Test (CBT 1) under Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) 04/2026. Candidates who applied for the Junior Engineer (JE) and other notified posts can download their e-call letters from the official website of their respective RRB region using their registration number and date of birth. The admit card release process began on October 23, 2026, ahead of the CBT 1 examinations scheduled for October 27, 28 and 30, 2026, according to the examination schedule provided. The e-call letter contains essential information, including the examination date, shift, reporting time and examination centre. Candidates must download and print their admit cards and carry a valid photo identity document to the examination centre. They should also read the instructions mentioned on the hall ticket carefully before appearing for the examination. RRB JE admit card 2026: Steps to download hall tickets
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the RRB JE admit card 2026 from the official website: Visit the official website of the regional Railway Recruitment Board through which you applied.
 Find the link titled “CEN 04/2026 RRB JE CBT 1 E-Call Letter” or the corresponding admit card notification.
 Click the link to open the candidate login page.
 Enter your registration number and date of birth in the prescribed format.
 Submit the login details to access your admit card.
 Check your name, roll number, examination date, shift timing and examination centre.
 Download the admit card and take a clear printout for examination day.
 RRB JE hall ticket 2026: Details mentioned
 The admit card serves as an important document for verifying a candidate's identity and examination details. It contains the following information: Candidate's name
 Roll number and registration number
 Date of birth
 Photograph and signature
 Category
 Examination name and CEN number
 Examination date and shift
 Reporting time and gate closing time
 Examination centre name and address
 Examination-day instructions
 Candidates should ensure that the photograph and signature are clearly visible and that their personal details match the information submitted in the application form. What happens after the RRB JE CBT 1 examination?
 CBT 1 is the first stage of the RRB JE recruitment process. Candidates who qualify at this stage, subject to the applicable recruitment rules and shortlisting criteria, will proceed to the next stage of selection. The subsequent stages include CBT 2, document verification and a medical examination, as applicable to the notified post and recruitment rules. Candidates should regularly check official RRB notifications for updates on examination results, cut-off marks and the next stage of the recruitment process. Candidates appearing for the examination should download their e-call letters as soon as they become available, verify the details, and follow all instructions issued by their respective Railway Recruitment Boards.
